title.zh: 平台 | API 更新日志上线

summary.en: Public developer timeline for model launches, capability changes, pricing, and platform notes.
summary.zh: 面向开发者的公开时间线：模型上新、能力变更、定价与平台说明。

body.en:
OmniMux now publishes an **API Updates** timeline so you can track gateway changes without digging through chats or release notes elsewhere.

## What this feed covers

- **New models** — callable model IDs added on live pricing
- **Model updates** — new modes, durations, resolutions, parameters
- **Pricing** — material rate or settlement changes
- **Breaking** — incompatible request/response or path changes
- **Platform** — auth, domains, and public HTTP surfaces (for example Social Ops publishing)

## How to use OmniMux today

| Surface | URL |
| --- | --- |
| Console | `https://omnimux.ai` |
| OpenAI-compatible API | `https://api.omnimux.ai/v1` |
| Docs | `https://docs.omnimux.ai` |
| Status | `https://status.omnimux.ai` |

Relay auth: Bearer `sk-…` from the console.

## Note on earlier capability

Entries dated **2026-08-09** that describe language, image, video, or social-data families document capabilities **already available** on the gateway when this feed started. They are not fabricated per-model first-launch history. Later entries are append-only real changes.

Full model inventory always lives on console pricing — this page is a **change timeline**, not a second catalog.
body.zh:
OmniMux 现提供 **API 更新** 时间线，便于跟踪网关侧模型与协议变更，而无需翻聊天或零散发布说明。

## 本时间线覆盖范围

- **新模型** — 线上定价新增可调用的模型 ID
- **模型更新** — 新模式、时长、分辨率、参数
- **价格调整** — 实质费率或结算规则变化
- **不兼容变更** — 请求/响应或路径不兼容
- **平台** — 鉴权、域名、公开 HTTP 面（如社媒发布）

## 当前使用入口

| 面 | URL |
| --- | --- |
| 控制台 | `https://omnimux.ai` |
| OpenAI 兼容 API | `https://api.omnimux.ai/v1` |
| 文档 | `https://docs.omnimux.ai` |
| 状态页 | `https://status.omnimux.ai` |

Relay 鉴权：控制台签发的 Bearer `sk-…`。

## 关于早期能力

日期为 **2026-08-09**、描述语言 / 图像 / 视频 / 社交数据等族的条目，记录的是本时间线上线时网关上 **已可调用** 的能力，**不是**伪造的逐模型首发史。之后条目为只追加的真实变更。

完整模型清单以控制台定价为准——本页是 **变更时间线**，不是第二份目录。

title.en: New Model | Language series — Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok & more
title.zh: 新模型 | 语言系列 — Claude / GPT / Gemini / Grok 等

summary.en: Chat Completions language brands are available on the gateway (already live when this feed opened).
summary.zh: 语言品牌已通过 Chat Completions 可调用（本时间线上线时已在网关可用）。

body.en:
Language generation brands are **already available** on OmniMux through OpenAI-compatible **Chat Completions** at `https://api.omnimux.ai/v1`.

## New model

Representative model IDs (pin the exact ID from live pricing / docs enums):

| Brand | Example model IDs |
| --- | --- |
| Claude | `claude-opus-5`, `claude-sonnet-5`, `claude-haiku-4-5` |
| GPT | `gpt-5.5`, `gpt-5.6-terra` |
| Gemini | `gemini-3.6-flash`, `gemini-3.1-pro` |
| Grok | `grok-4.5` |
| DeepSeek | `deepseek-v4-pro` |
| GLM | `glm-5.2` |
| Kimi | `kimi-k3` |
| MiniMax (text) | `minimax-m3` |

## Contract

- One **complete** docs page per brand (`model` is an enum on the page).
- Use model IDs from console pricing or the brand complete page only.

## Documentation

Start from the **Language series** tab in the API manual (links below).
body.zh:
语言生成品牌 **已在** OmniMux 可调用，主路径为 OpenAI 兼容 **Chat Completions**：`https://api.omnimux.ai/v1`。

## 新模型

代表性模型 ID（精确 ID 以线上定价 / 文档枚举为准）：

| 品牌 | 示例模型 ID |
| --- | --- |
| Claude | `claude-opus-5`、`claude-sonnet-5`、`claude-haiku-4-5` |
| GPT | `gpt-5.5`、`gpt-5.6-terra` |
| Gemini | `gemini-3.6-flash`、`gemini-3.1-pro` |
| Grok | `grok-4.5` |
| DeepSeek | `deepseek-v4-pro` |
| GLM | `glm-5.2` |
| Kimi | `kimi-k3` |
| MiniMax（文本） | `minimax-m3` |

## 调用约定

- 每个品牌一页 **完整参数**（`model` 为页内枚举）。
- 模型 ID 请以控制台定价或品牌完整参数页为准。

## 文档

见 API 手册 **语言系列**（下方链接）。

title.en: New Model | Image generation — GPT Image 2, Nano Banana, Midjourney & more
title.zh: 新模型 | 图像生成 — GPT Image 2 / Nano Banana / Midjourney 等

summary.en: Image generation SKUs available on live pricing when this feed opened.
summary.zh: 本时间线上线时，线上定价已提供的图像生成能力。

body.en:
Image generation models are **already available** on the OmniMux gateway.

## New model

| Model ID | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| `gpt-image2` | GPT Image 2 primary SKU |
| `gpt-image2-hd` | Higher-detail / HD tier |
| `nano_banana_2` | Nano Banana 2 |
| `nano_banana_pro` | Nano Banana Pro |
| `zimage-makeup` | Makeup / beauty workflow-oriented image model |
| `midjourney` | Midjourney image path on live pricing |

## Key capabilities

- Text-to-image and product/creative image workflows via gateway model IDs
- Pin the exact model ID from live pricing before integrating

## Documentation

See **Image series** in the API manual. Full inventory remains on console pricing.
body.zh:
图像生成模型 **已在** OmniMux 网关可调用。

## 新模型

| 模型 ID | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `gpt-image2` | GPT Image 2 主 SKU |
| `gpt-image2-hd` | 更高细节 / HD 档 |
| `nano_banana_2` | Nano Banana 2 |
| `nano_banana_pro` | Nano Banana Pro |
| `zimage-makeup` | 美妆向图像工作流模型 |

## 关键能力

- 通过网关模型 ID 做文生图与创意/商品图工作流

## 文档

title.en: New Model | Video generation — Omni Flash, MiniMax H3, Veo, Kling, Seedance
title.zh: 新模型 | 视频生成 — Omni Flash / MiniMax H3 / Veo / Kling / Seedance

summary.en: Async video SKUs available when this feed opened: create then poll task status.
summary.zh: 本时间线上线时已可用的异步视频能力：先创建任务再查询状态。

body.en:
Video generation on OmniMux is primarily **async** and **already available** on the gateway:

- Create: `POST /v1/video/generations`
- Poll: `GET /v1/video/generations/{task_id}`

## New model

| Model ID | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `omni_flash`, `omni_flash-4s` / `-6s` / `-10s` | Omni Flash duration family |
| `minimax-h3-t2v` | MiniMax H3 text-to-video |
| `minimax-h3-flf` / `minimax-h3-fl2va` / `minimax-h3-endframe` | MiniMax H3 image / frame variants |
| `veo_3_1` | Veo 3.1 |
| `grok-imagine-video-1.5` | Grok Imagine Video |
| `ltx2.3-kj` | LTX family SKU |
| `kling-v2-6`, `kling-v3` | Kling video SKUs on live pricing |
| `seedance-2-0`, `seedance-2-0-fast`, `seedance-2-0-mini`, `seedance-2-5` | Seedance family on live pricing |

## Key capabilities

- Submit once, poll task status until assets are ready
- Do not confuse task poll with content-download-only paths

## Documentation

See **Video series** and **Task management**. Exact IDs always from live pricing.
body.zh:
OmniMux 视频生成以 **异步任务** 为主，且 **已在** 网关可调用：

- 创建：`POST /v1/video/generations`
- 查询：`GET /v1/video/generations/{task_id}`

## 新模型

| 模型 ID | 角色 |
| --- | --- |
| `omni_flash`、`omni_flash-4s` / `-6s` / `-10s` | Omni Flash 时长族 |
| `minimax-h3-t2v` | MiniMax H3 文生视频 |
| `minimax-h3-flf` / `minimax-h3-fl2va` / `minimax-h3-endframe` | MiniMax H3 图/帧变体 |
| `veo_3_1` | Veo 3.1 |
| `grok-imagine-video-1.5` | Grok Imagine Video |
| `ltx2.3-kj` | LTX 系 SKU |
| `kling-v2-6`、`kling-v3` | 线上定价中的 Kling 视频 |
| `seedance-2-0`、`seedance-2-0-fast`、`seedance-2-0-mini`、`seedance-2-5` | 线上定价中的 Seedance 族 |

## 关键能力

- 提交一次后轮询任务状态直至产出就绪
- 勿与纯内容下载路径混淆

## 文档

见 **视频系列** 与 **任务管理**。精确 ID 始终以线上定价为准。

title.en: New Model | Social data — TikTok, Instagram, X, YouTube (read-only)
title.zh: 新模型 | 社交数据 — TikTok / Instagram / X / YouTube（只读）

summary.en: Read-only social data models via Chat Completions-style IDs — not publishing.
summary.zh: 只读社交数据模型（Chat Completions 形态模型 ID）——不是社媒发布。

body.en:
**Social data** is **read-only** public content / profile style access. It is **not** social publishing.

## New model

| Platform | Model IDs |
| --- | --- |
| TikTok | `tiktok-user`, `tiktok-posts`, `tiktok-video`, `tiktok-search` |
| Instagram | `instagram-user`, `instagram-posts`, `instagram-post`, `instagram-search` |
| X | `x-user`, `x-posts`, `x-tweet`, `x-search` |
| YouTube | `youtube-user`, `youtube-posts`, `youtube-video`, `youtube-search` |

## Publishing (different surface)

Connect accounts and create posts use **`/api/social/v1/*`** with access token + `New-Api-User` — see **Publishing** in the API manual. Do not mix auth models with gateway `sk-` Chat Completions.

## Documentation

See **Social data** groups under the API manual (links below).
body.zh:
**社交数据**是 **只读** 的公开内容/资料类能力，**不是** 社媒发布。

## 新模型

| 平台 | 模型 ID |
| --- | --- |
| TikTok | `tiktok-user`、`tiktok-posts`、`tiktok-video`、`tiktok-search` |
| Instagram | `instagram-user`、`instagram-posts`、`instagram-post`、`instagram-search` |
| X | `x-user`、`x-posts`、`x-tweet`、`x-search` |
| YouTube | `youtube-user`、`youtube-posts`、`youtube-video`、`youtube-search` |

## 社媒发布（另一套面）

连接账户与发帖走 **`/api/social/v1/*`**，鉴权为 access token + `New-Api-User`，见 API 手册 **社媒发布**。勿与网关 `sk-` Chat Completions 混用鉴权。

## 文档

见 API 手册 **社交数据** 分组（下方链接）。
